parsed.summary: The PR refactors AutocompleteJsonView to support extra fields in the autocomplete response by introducing a new method serialize_result(). The change is minimal and maintains existing functionality.

issues.description: The docstring for the new serialize_result() method could be more detailed to explain its purpose and parameters.
